instruction: A group portrait photograph of four people sitting side-by-side on a grassy lawn in a park. From left to right: the East Asian man in the red t-shirt (R3) points forward with a smile; the woman in the navy t-shirt (R4) sits smiling; the Black woman with the afro (R6) in a red t-shirt points forward; and the bald man in the navy t-shirt (R2) sits smiling. Their shirts feature large letters that collectively spell out the word 'TEAM'. The lighting is bright and even, capturing a cheerful, sunny day outdoors.
